name: FA complementation group E

function.text: FANCE encodes fanconi anemia group E protein. It participates in interstrand cross-link repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Fanconi anemia complementation group E (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: FANCE encodes Fanconi anemia group E protein. It is required for the nuclear accumulation of FANCC and provides a critical bridge between the FA complex and FANCD2.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with Fanconi anemia complementation group E (autosomal recessive).
